ai_summary: Anmol India Limited announced its promoter, Chakshu Goyal, pledged 3,295,400 equity shares to State Bank of India on September 2, 2026, as collateral for credit facilities availed by the company. While securing necessary financing, this action introduces a material risk: a potential default on these loans could lead to the invocation of the shares, negatively impacting promoter holdings and potentially placing downward pressure on the stock price.
